description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. Naval Surface Warfare Center Carderock Division (NSWCCD) intends to award a firm fixed price (FFP) purchase order using Simplified Acquisition Procedures.

The Government intends to solicit for a Photocentric (or equivalent) SLA Machine as detailed in the attached solicitation. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation and a written solicitation will not be issued.

This is procurement IS set aside for small business.  The NAICS code is 333248 and the Small Business Standard is 750 Employees.

All inquiries should be directed to Tracy McDonough at tracy.l.mcdonough2.civ@us.navy.mil
